correctness.rationale: The full construction and all quantifiers are proved in RESULT.md. The convergent digit embedding admits a first-discrepancy Euclidean comparison with fixed δ>0, preserved under arbitrary integer translations of the 2-adic group. Cylinder separation bounds yield \(\log s_n=k(n)\log2+O(1)\) and uniform Haar Bowen-ball logarithms. Block lengths \(2^{j^2}\) force the full pair of liminf/limsup dimension ratios. Uniform unique ergodicity sends empirical measures into every μ-neighborhood uniformly, giving PS=topological counts for all large n. The standalone script from the embedded package passed 146320 finite checks; the universal claims do not depend on those finite checks.

value.rationale: The precise gap question is motivated by the nonminimal example in Chen–Xie–Zhou: can strictly different lower/upper PS rates survive unique ergodicity and minimality? The new construction answers yes for every interior pair with Euclidean metric and all-iterates uniform bi-Lipschitz control. It identifies geometry, not orbit nonuniformity or multiplicity of invariant measures, as a sufficient cause, while all dynamical examples remain topologically conjugate to one classical system. This is a natural complete interior-pair realization, not an arbitrary finite computation.
